verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a broad API (CKS cluster CRUD, Terraform provider covering CKS/VPC/storage/inference, Inference API for gateways/deployments/capacity) confirmed live via a runtime probe (401 Bearer-gated), and notes some UI-only helpers like Capacity Finder that lack a documented API equivalent. Not all Cloud Console features (e.g., billing insights, quota views, Capacity Finder) are explicitly confirmed as API-accessible, so full UI/API parity isn't demonstrated. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for billing insights/quota viewing, explicit API equivalent for Capacity Finder, independent third-party confirmation of full UI/API parity.
